dialogue.remcompanion.rem.stranger.0: ...I don't know you. What do you want from me?
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.stranger.1: Please keep your distance. I don't know if I can trust you yet.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.stranger.2: I'm hungry... Maybe if you brought me something to eat, we could talk.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.first_gift: Is this... for me? Thank you. You're kind. From now on I'll go with you, if you'll have me.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.too_many_gifts: You just gave me plenty... I'm fine, really.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.other_owner: I'm sorry, my heart already belongs to someone else.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.stay: Alright, I'll wait here. Come back soon.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.death: Rem has fallen... Your companion is gone.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s1.0: I'm still learning what this world is like. Thank you for taking me along.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s1.1: I'll do my best to be useful. When there's danger, I'll step forward.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s1.2: I'm not as strong as I look... but I won't give up.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s2.0: It's nice walking beside you. I feel at ease.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s2.1: Are you alright? If you're tired, rest. I'll keep watch.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s2.2: I'd like to cook for you someday. At least I can clean... and fight!
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s3.0: Every day with you makes me want to keep going.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s3.1: If anyone tries to hurt you, they'll have to get through me first.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s3.2: You don't have to carry everything alone. That's what I'm here for.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s4.0: You are the most important person to me. I'll protect you with everything I have.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s4.1: Thank you for finding me. My life has meaning because I'm by your side.
dialogue.remcompanion.rem.s4.2: No matter what happens, I'll always be with you.
